cap-nhat-tien-do-thi-cong-gian-hang-skv-.title: Construction update: the SKV Lighting booth at PLASE Show Hanoi 2026

cung-skv-lighting-kham-pha-gian-hang-boe.summary: As BOE's authorized dealer in Vietnam, the SKV Lighting team spent InfoComm Asia 2026 at the BOE booth, exploring the latest LED display technology first-hand and talking with BOE's experts.

dang-ky-tham-quan-plase-show-ha-noi-2026.title: Register for PLASE Show Hanoi 2026 and get a 20% voucher from SKV Lighting
dang-ky-tham-quan-plase-show-ha-noi-2026.summary: Facing challenges with your LED system, video processing or presentation control? Meet our experts in person at the SKV Lighting booth, Booth 31, Hall 6, at PLASE Show Hanoi 2026.

skv-chinh-thuc-tro-thanh-nha-phan-phoi-d.summary: Vietnam's LED display market is growing fast, with rising demand for image quality, durability and reliable operation. SKV is now officially BOE's exclusive distributor in Vietnam.

skv-lighting-chinh-thuc-tro-thanh-nha-ph.summary: As Vietnam's LED display market demands ever better image quality, processing and reliability, SKV Lighting is now an authorized distributor of NovaStar, one of the world's leading LED control brands.
